summary: The production character profile previously exposed the bright turntable background between the retained seated pelvis and the assembled MetaHuman upper legs. Opaque Profile Hips V1 retains two pose-matched wetsuit hip roots, buries their proximal ends inside the pelvis, and uses a closed tapered mesh instead of a stretched sphere. The guide and all four crew profiles now keep a continuous opaque waist-to-upper-leg silhouette without the rejected round hip-pad artifact.

root_cause.production_visibility_gap: SetProceduralVisualVisible(false) retained the project-owned pelvis but hid both pose-matched thigh roots, while the assembled production legs did not close the profile junction to that pelvis shell.
root_cause.material_diagnosis: The retained pelvis and wetsuit materials were already BLEND_Opaque; the apparent transparency was literal background visible through missing junction geometry, not alpha blending.
root_cause.rejected_full_thigh_candidate: Retaining the existing full 8.3 cm-radius stretched-sphere thighs closed the hole but created oversized round hip pads and an inflated rear silhouette.
root_cause.rejected_short_sphere_candidate: Shorter 6.8 cm-radius stretched spheres reduced the volume but kept a visibly bulbous proximal joint.
root_cause.retained_shape: A 377-vertex closed tapered tube per side, spanning -0.15 to 0.58 of the solved hip-to-knee segment. Its narrow caps remain inside overlapping pelvis and assembled-leg geometry.

renderer_evidence.technical_verdict: pass: all five front/profile/rear turntables retain opaque hip junctions; guide and broadest profiles show no background between pelvis and upper leg
renderer_evidence.photoreal_verdict: fail pending named review or replacement of the still-simplified procedural pelvis/thigh anatomy, seams, deformation and wet material response

validation.focused_python: 36/36 production-character, safety-gear, and flexible-raft source contracts passed

validation.failed_diagnostic: M9V577OpaqueProfileHipsM5Renderer was rejected because its 10.5 cm turntable half-length floor did not admit the valid 9.82 cm live rescue-pose bridge; it is not retained as passing evidence.
